record.paper_title: Separability of Topological Groups: A Survey with Open Problems
record.original_question: In ZFC alone, does there exist a separable countably compact topological group that contains a non-separable closed subgroup?

evidence.quote: Does there exist in ZFC a separable countably compact topological group which contains a non-separable closed subgroup?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A topological group is a group $G$ equipped with a topology making the multiplication $G\times G\to G$ and inversion $G\to G$ continuous. A topological space is called separable if it has a countable dense subset, and countably compact if every countable open cover has a finite subcover (equivalently, every infinite subset has an accumulation point). A subgroup $H\le G$ is closed if it is closed as a subset of the topological space $G$.

Working in ZFC alone (i.e., without assuming any additional set-theoretic axioms such as the Continuum Hypothesis or Martin's Axiom), does there exist a separable countably compact topological group $G$ that contains a closed subgroup $H$ which is not separable?
artifact.status_search_result: Under the Continuum Hypothesis, separable countably compact abelian groups with a closed non-separable subgroup are known to exist. Whether such an example can be constructed in ZFC alone is reported as an open problem in surveys on separability of topological groups, with no ZFC construction located.

status_evidence.title: Separability of Topological Groups: A Survey with Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Does there exist in ZFC a separable countably compact topological group which contains a non-separable closed subgroup?
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as open in this survey on separability of topological groups.

status_evidence.title: Topological groups whose closed subgroups are separable, and the product operation
status_evidence.snippet: Recent results give ZFC examples of precompact abelian groups G, H with all closed subgroups separable, but G×H contains a closed non-separable subgroup; CH yields a separable countably compact abelian group with a closed non-separable subgroup.
status_evidence.claim: Single-group ZFC version still appears to be unresolved; CH-based example is known.
